column1: # Numerals that are allowed to appear in tex/main.tex as literals.
# Format: <token><TAB><reason>. `papertool numbers` fails the build on a decimal or a
# three-digit integer that is not listed here and is not a \val{...} lookup, so every number
# in the paper is either generated from data/measurements.json or explained below.
# The reasons group into four kinds: layout constants of the LaTeX source, constants of the
# *audited* code (not measurements of this paper), constants of the experiment plan that the
# prose quotes in passing, and verbatim claims of the audited repository.
